Turk Mevzuat.title: Türk Mevzuat
Turk Mevzuat.description: Turkish primary legislation from mevzuat.gov.tr: 27 statutes (Constitution, Civil Code, Code of Obligations, Commercial Code, Criminal Code, civil/criminal/administrative procedure, KVKK data protection, consumer and labour law). Article search in Turkish, full text, paragraph-level citations ("KVKK m. 5/2-ç"), Official Gazette references, checked daily against the official source. Read-only, no auth.
